fullText.simplified:
十二、努力带来希望

    小黄猫：
    你好吗？你到猫乐园了吗？
    过去的这两个星期真难，我和小白又遇到了那只大雕。这一次，小白被大雕抓住了。我一个人爬上雪山，在一个山洞里找到了小白。大雕要吃小白。虽然我不知道该怎么办，但还是想带他离开那儿。小白特别聪明，他抓住了一个机会，咬住了大雕的翅膀。我再用石头打了大雕的眼睛。大雕不能飞，也看不见了。他掉下了雪山，再也不能吃猫了。
    雪山是个让小白难过的地方，因为他哥哥在这儿被大雕吃了。对了，我还没有告诉你，小白有个哥哥。两年前他跟哥哥去猫乐园，经过雪山时，遇到了大雕，大雕吃了他哥哥。小黄猫，小白打你的那件事，你还生气吗？我已经不生气了。如果有机会了解小白，你会知道，他其实不坏。
    你还记得那只在草地里等姐姐回来的小羊吗？听大雕说他姐姐被人卖了，再也回不来了。这真是太让人难过了。小白说你可能也知道小羊的姐姐被人卖了，是这样吗？因为不想小羊太难过，所以你没有告诉他，对不对？
    小黄猫，小声地告诉你，在爬雪山以前，我其实是有些害怕的。我害怕我爬不上雪山，害怕遇到大雕。我没有想到自己会做得这么好，不但爬上了雪山，还打了大雕。小白说这是因为我很努力，他说我和以前不一样了，他让我相信自己。我想他说得对，我应该相信自己。现在我已经下雪山了，离猫乐园越来越近了，我会努力地走下去。努力带来希望，希望一直都在，我相信我会找到你的！
    想你的饭饭
fullText.traditional:
十二、努力帶來希望

    小黃貓：
    你好嗎？你到貓樂園了嗎？
    過去的這兩個星期真難，我和小白又遇到了那隻大鵰。這一次，小白被大鵰抓住了。我一個人爬上雪山，在一個山洞裡找到了小白。大鵰要吃小白。雖然我不知道該怎麼辦，但還是想帶他離開那兒。小白特別聰明，他抓住了一個機會，咬住了大鵰的翅膀。我再用石頭打了大鵰的眼睛。大鵰不能飛，也看不見了。他掉下了雪山，再也不能吃貓了。
    雪山是個讓小白難過的地方，因為他哥哥在這兒被大鵰吃了。對了，我還沒有告訴你，小白有個哥哥。兩年前他跟哥哥去貓樂園，經過雪山時，遇到了大鵰，大鵰吃了他哥哥。小黃貓，小白打你的那件事，你還生氣嗎？我已經不生氣了。如果有機會了解小白，你會知道，他其實不壞。
    你還記得那隻在草地裡等姐姐回來的小羊嗎？聽大鵰說他姐姐被人賣了，再也回不來了。這真是太讓人難過了。小白說你可能也知道小羊的姐姐被人賣了，是這樣嗎？因為不想小羊太難過，所以你沒有告訴他，對不對？
    小黃貓，小聲地告訴你，在爬雪山以前，我其實是有些害怕的。我害怕我爬不上雪山，害怕遇到大鵰。我沒有想到自己會做得這麼好，不但爬上了雪山，還打了大鵰。小白說這是因為我很努力，他說我和以前不一樣了，他讓我相信自己。我想他說得對，我應該相信自己。現在我已經下雪山了，離貓樂園越來越近了，我會努力地走下去。努力帶來希望，希望一直都在，我相信我會找到你的！
    想你的飯飯

sentences.simplified: 小黄猫：
sentences.traditional: 小黃貓：
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo huáng māo
sentences.english: Little yellow cat:

sentences.simplified: 你好吗？你到猫乐园了吗？
sentences.traditional: 你好嗎？你到貓樂園了嗎？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ hǎo ma nǐ dào māo lè yuán le ma
sentences.english: How are you? Have you arrived at the cat paradise?

sentences.simplified: 过去的这两个星期真难，我和小白又遇到了那只大雕。
sentences.traditional: 過去的這兩個星期真難，我和小白又遇到了那隻大鵰。
sentences.pinyin: guò qù de zhè liǎng ge xīng qī zhēn nán wǒ hé xiǎo bái yòu yù dào le nà zhī dà diāo
sentences.english: The past two weeks have been really tough. Little Bai and I came across the big eagle again.

sentences.simplified: 这一次，小白被大雕抓住了。
sentences.traditional: 這一次，小白被大鵰抓住了。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yí cì xiǎo bái bèi dà diāo zhuā zhù le
sentences.english: This time, Little Bai was caught by the big eagle.

sentences.simplified: 我一个人爬上雪山，在一个山洞里找到了小白。
sentences.traditional: 我一個人爬上雪山，在一個山洞裡找到了小白。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ yí ge rén pá shàng xuě shān zài yí ge shān dòng lǐ zhǎo dào le xiǎo bái
sentences.english: I climbed up the snowy mountain alone and found Little Bai in a cave.

sentences.simplified: 大雕要吃小白。
sentences.traditional: 大鵰要吃小白。
sentences.pinyin: dà diāo yào chī xiǎo bái
sentences.english: The big eagle wanted to eat Little Bai.

sentences.simplified: 虽然我不知道该怎么办，但还是想带他离开那儿。
sentences.traditional: 雖然我不知道該怎麼辦，但還是想帶他離開那兒。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán wǒ bù zhī dào gāi zěn me bàn dàn hái shi xiǎng dài tā lí kāi nà'r
sentences.english: Although I didn’t know what to do, I still wanted to bring him out of there.

sentences.simplified: 小白特别聪明，他抓住了一个机会，咬住了大雕的翅膀。
sentences.traditional: 小白特別聰明，他抓住了一個機會，咬住了大鵰的翅膀。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo bái tè bié cōng ming tā zhuā zhù le yí ge jī huì yǎo zhù le dà diāo de chì bǎng
sentences.english: Little Bai was very clever. He took advantage of an opportunity and bit the big eagle’s wing.

sentences.simplified: 我再用石头打了大雕的眼睛。大雕不能飞，也看不见了。
sentences.traditional: 我再用石頭打了大鵰的眼睛。大鵰不能飛，也看不見了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zài yòng shí tou dǎ le dà diāo de yǎn jing dà diāo bù néng fēi yě kàn bú jiàn le
sentences.english: Then, I hit the big eagle’s eyes with a rock. The big eagle couldn’t fly, and he couldn’t see anymore.

sentences.simplified: 他掉下了雪山，再也不能吃猫了。
sentences.traditional: 他掉下了雪山，再也不能吃貓了。
sentences.pinyin: tā diào xià le xuě shān zài yě bù néng chī māo le
sentences.english: He fell off the snowy mountain, and wouldn’t ever be able to eat a cat again.

sentences.simplified: 雪山是个让小白难过的地方，因为他哥哥在这儿被大雕吃了。
sentences.traditional: 雪山是個讓小白難過的地方，因為他哥哥在這兒被大鵰吃了。
sentences.pinyin: xuě shān shì ge ràng xiǎo bái nán guò de dì fang yīn wèi tā gē ge zài zhè‘r bèi dà diāo chī le
sentences.english: The snowy mountain was a place that made Little Bai sad because his older brother was eaten by the big eagle there.

sentences.simplified: 对了，我还没有告诉你，小白有个哥哥。
sentences.traditional: 對了，我還沒有告訴你，小白有個哥哥。
sentences.pinyin: duì le wǒ hái méi yǒu gào su nǐ xiǎo bái yǒu ge gē ge
sentences.english: By the way, I haven’t told you yet. Little Bai had an older brother.

sentences.simplified: 两年前他跟哥哥去猫乐园，
sentences.traditional: 兩年前他跟哥哥去貓樂園，
sentences.pinyin: liǎng nián qián tā gēn gē ge qù māo lè yuán
sentences.english: Two years ago, he was going to the cat paradise with his older brother.

sentences.simplified: 经过雪山时，遇到了大雕，大雕吃了他哥哥。
sentences.traditional: 經過雪山時，遇到了大鵰，大鵰吃了他哥哥。
sentences.pinyin: jīng guò xuě shān shí yù dào le dà diāo dà diāo chī le tā gē ge
sentences.english: While passing through the snowy mountain, they came across the big eagle, and the big eagle ate his older brother.

sentences.simplified: 小黄猫，小白打你的那件事，你还生气吗？
sentences.traditional: 小黃貓，小白打你的那件事，你還生氣嗎？
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo huáng māo xiǎo bái dǎ nǐ de nà jiàn shì nǐ hái shēng qì ma
sentences.english: Little yellow cat, are you still angry about the time Little Bai hit you?

sentences.simplified: 我已经不生气了。如果有机会了解小白，你会知道，他其实不坏。
sentences.traditional: 我已經不生氣了。如果有機會了解小白，你會知道，他其實不壞。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ yǐ jīng bù shēng qì le rú guǒ yǒu jī huì liǎo jiě xiǎo bái nǐ huì zhī dào tā qí shí bú huài
sentences.english: I’m not angry anymore. If you have the chance to get to know Little Bai, you will find that he is actually not a bad cat.

sentences.simplified: 你还记得那只在草地里等姐姐回来的小羊吗？
sentences.traditional: 你還記得那隻在草地裡等姐姐回來的小羊嗎？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ hái jì de nà zhī zài cǎo dì lǐ děng jiě jie huí lái de xiǎo yáng ma
sentences.english: Do you remember the little lamb waiting on the grass for his older sister to return?

sentences.simplified: 听大雕说他姐姐被人卖了，再也回不来了。
sentences.traditional: 聽大鵰說他姐姐被人賣了，再也回不來了。
sentences.pinyin: tīng dà diāo shuō tā jiě jie bèi rén mài le zài yě huí bù lái le
sentences.english: I heard the big eagle say that his older sister had been sold and would never come back.

sentences.simplified: 这真是太让人难过了。
sentences.traditional: 這真是太讓人難過了。
sentences.pinyin: zhè zhēn shi tài ràng rén nán guò le
sentences.english: This is really so sad.

sentences.simplified: 小白说你可能也知道小羊的姐姐被人卖了，是这样吗？
sentences.traditional: 小白說你可能也知道小羊的姐姐被人賣了，是這樣嗎？
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo bái shuō nǐ kě néng yě zhī dào xiǎo yáng de jiě jie bèi rén mài le shì zhè yàng ma
sentences.english: Little Bai said that you might have also known that the little lamb’s older sister was sold. Is that true?

sentences.simplified: 因为不想小羊太难过，所以你没有告诉他，对不对？
sentences.traditional: 因為不想小羊太難過，所以你沒有告訴他，對不對？
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi bù xiǎng xiǎo yáng tài nán guò suǒ yǐ nǐ méi yǒu gào su tā duì bú duì
sentences.english: But because you didn’t want the little lamb to be sad, you didn’t tell him, right?

sentences.simplified: 小黄猫，小声地告诉你，在爬雪山以前，我其实是有些害怕的。
sentences.traditional: 小黃貓，小聲地告訴你，在爬雪山以前，我其實是有些害怕的。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo huáng māo xiǎo shēng de gào su nǐ zài pá xuě shān yǐ qián wǒ qí shí shì yǒu xiē hài pà de
sentences.english: Little yellow cat, I’ll tell you quietly, that before climbing the snowy mountain, I was actually a bit scared.

sentences.simplified: 我害怕我爬不上雪山，害怕遇到大雕。
sentences.traditional: 我害怕我爬不上雪山，害怕遇到大鵰。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ hài pà wǒ pá bú shàng xuě shān hài pà yù dào dà diāo
sentences.english: I was scared that I wouldn’t make it up the snowy mountain, and I was scared of coming across the big eagle.

sentences.simplified: 我没有想到自己会做得这么好，不但爬上了雪山，还打了大雕。
sentences.traditional: 我沒有想到自己會做得這麼好，不但爬上了雪山，還打了大鵰。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ méi yǒu xiǎng dào zì jǐ huì zuò de zhè me hǎo bú dàn pá shàng le xuě shān hái dǎ le dà diāo
sentences.english: I didn’t expect myself to do so well. Not only did I climb the snowy mountain, but I also hit the big eagle.

sentences.simplified: 小白说这是因为我很努力，他说我和以前不一样了，他让我相信自己。
sentences.traditional: 小白說這是因為我很努力，他說我和以前不一樣了，他讓我相信自己。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo bái shuō zhè shì yīn wèi wǒ hěn nǔ lì tā shuō wǒ hé yǐ qián bù yí yàng le tā ràng wǒ xiāng xìn zì jǐ
sentences.english: Little Bai said it’s because I’ve been working hard. He said I’m different from before. He made me believe in myself.

sentences.simplified: 我想他说得对，我应该相信自己。
sentences.traditional: 我想他說得對，我應該相信自己。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng tā shuō de duì wǒ yīng gāi xiāng xìn zì jǐ
sentences.english: I think he’s right. I should believe in myself.

sentences.simplified: 现在我已经下雪山了，
sentences.traditional: 現在我已經下雪山了，
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài wǒ yǐ jīng xià xuě shān le
sentences.english: Now, I’ve already come down the snowy mountain.

sentences.simplified: 离猫乐园越来越近了，我会努力地走下去。
sentences.traditional: 離貓樂園越來越近了，我會努力地走下去。
sentences.pinyin: lí māo lè yuán yuè lái yuè jìn le wǒ huì nǔ lì de zǒu xià qù
sentences.english: I’m getting closer and closer to the cat paradise. I will work hard and keep on walking.

sentences.simplified: 努力带来希望，希望一直都在，我相信我会找到你的！
sentences.traditional: 努力帶來希望，希望一直都在，我相信我會找到你的！
sentences.pinyin: nǔ lì dài lái xī wàng xī wàng yì zhí dōu zài wǒ xiāng xìn wǒ huì zhǎo dào nǐ de
sentences.english: Hard work brings hope, and hope will always be there. I believe that I will find you!

sentences.simplified: 想你的饭饭
sentences.traditional: 想你的飯飯
sentences.pinyin: xiǎng nǐ de fàn fàn
sentences.english: Missing you, Fanfan

sentence_translations: (12) Hard Work Brings Hope
Little yellow cat:
How are you? Have you arrived at the cat paradise?
The past two weeks have been really tough. Little Bai and I came across the big eagle again.
This time, Little Bai was caught by the big eagle.
I climbed up the snowy mountain alone and found Little Bai in a cave.
The big eagle wanted to eat Little Bai.
Although I didn’t know what to do, I still wanted to bring him out of there.
Little Bai was very clever. He took advantage of an opportunity and bit the big eagle’s wing.
Then, I hit the big eagle’s eyes with a rock. The big eagle couldn’t fly, and he couldn’t see anymore.
He fell off the snowy mountain, and wouldn’t ever be able to eat a cat again.
The snowy mountain was a place that made Little Bai sad because his older brother was eaten by the big eagle there.
By the way, I haven’t told you yet. Little Bai had an older brother.
Two years ago, he was going to the cat paradise with his older brother.
While passing through the snowy mountain, they came across the big eagle, and the big eagle ate his older brother.
Little yellow cat, are you still angry about the time Little Bai hit you?
I’m not angry anymore. If you have the chance to get to know Little Bai, you will find that he is actually not a bad cat.
Do you remember the little lamb waiting on the grass for his older sister to return?
I heard the big eagle say that his older sister had been sold and would never come back.
This is really so sad.
Little Bai said that you might have also known that the little lamb’s older sister was sold. Is that true?
But because you didn’t want the little lamb to be sad, you didn’t tell him, right?
Little yellow cat, I’ll tell you quietly, that before climbing the snowy mountain, I was actually a bit scared.
I was scared that I wouldn’t make it up the snowy mountain, and I was scared of coming across the big eagle.
I didn’t expect myself to do so well. Not only did I climb the snowy mountain, but I also hit the big eagle.
Little Bai said it’s because I’ve been working hard. He said I’m different from before. He made me believe in myself.
I think he’s right. I should believe in myself.
Now, I’ve already come down the snowy mountain.
I’m getting closer and closer to the cat paradise. I will work hard and keep on walking.
Hard work brings hope, and hope will always be there. I believe that I will find you!
Missing you, Fanfan
